Steam erlaubt Remote Play Together nur f: Steam only allows Remote Play Together for games it started itself. The trick: you borrow an installed Steam game that supports Remote Play Together as a donor. Instead of that game, Steam starts this app – and everything you launch from here is streamed by Steam as that game. Nothing about the donor game itself is changed, only its launch options.
